outline:

outline:
本課程主要在提供有志從事企業創新的學員充實創新思維與系統方法。內容包含如何辨識市場創新機會與問題；如何發展新創意滿足市場需求；如何發展最適商業模式。並介紹系統創新工具且提供實際國際創新企業成與敗的案例。其目的在於幫助學生們了解並學習系統創新方法與創新工具在新創產業之管理，及利用課程上的創新系統方法發展企業新契機。
The course focuses on the particular interest to those students who intend to development of an innovative business opportunity or innovation leadership. This course not only discusses the basics toolkits for every innovator needs, but also provides the practice workshop of systematic innovation. Major topics include how to identifying the market problems and opportunities; discover the novel ideas; develop the business models; demonstrate the innovative leadership. Many of the relevant good/bad cases will also be discussed in their entrepreneurial minds to build an innovative business model.
The objective is to develop an understanding systematic innovation approach and innovation toolkits to help students to have best practice in innovation management and to equip with the must-have innovation skills to pursue viable career options.
schedule:
Lecture 1st: Introduction ways to unleash your ideas and creativity.
Lecture 2nd: To Reframe Your Thinking to Be More Like an entrepreneur.
Lecture 3rd: Find Innovation Where You Least Expect It.
Lecture 4th: A systematic approach to innovation-1 and case discussion.
Lecture 5th: A systematic approach to innovation-2 and case discussion.
Lecture 6th: Choose the Right Innovation Method at the Right Time (1).
Lecture 7th: Choose the Right Innovation Method at the Right Time (2).
Lecture 8th: Discuss case: How Big Companies Undermine Innovation?
Lecture 9th: Presentation cases.
materials:
1. Originals: How Non-Conformists Move the World, Adam Grant.
2. Ten Types of Innovation: The Discipline of Building Breakthroughs, Larry Keeley, Helen Walters, Ryan Pikkel, Brian Quinn
